headline: "One plate of flounder costs this much?"... prices soared in the heatwave and are set to rise further
summary: Seafood prices are rising in Korea as heat damage hits farmed flounder, a fish known as a national sashimi fish. Farmed flounder are reported dying en masse, and prices are expected to rise further.
why: Heat-driven supply losses in aquaculture push up consumer food prices, and the trend can affect seafood retailers and food inflation in South Korea.
